items.question: are you looking for a job / open to roles?
aliases: 你现在开放工作机会吗？
items.answer:
Yes!!! I'm in the job market now. Recently I started actively applying for full-time AI PM roles at tech/AI companies starting at next summer/autumn. If you want to hire an intern NOW, I am also open with that!

PS: This is my email address [chenjy4@uw.edu](chenjy4@uw.edu) and this is my LinkedIn [https://www.linkedin.com/in/chenjie-yuan-682b93298/](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chenjie-yuan-682b93298/)

items.question: walk me through your most mature project.
aliases: what is your most mature project?
tell me about your best project.
介绍一下你最成熟的项目。
你最成熟的项目是什么？
items.answer: Use Agentic Hiring as the main example. It is a recruiting workbench I worked on at ByteDance. Its agent turns a role brief into a ranked candidate shortlist. I owned recommendation quality and product experience; a job taxonomy I designed raised the hiring-manager pass rate from 21% to 25% in a staged-rollout A/B test. Explain the problem, the product loop, what I owned, and the measured result in that order.

items.question: what are you building right now?
items.answer: I'm currently doing three part of things: 1) Research RA at UW helped with agent harness and model post-training; 2) Helped with building a agentic workflow in finding social media maker for commercial advertising (Haier the client); 3) Iterating on the content and AI QA Agent on my personal website.

items.question: how do I get in touch / contact you?
items.answer: Email and socials are in the Contact section — that is the fastest way to reach me.

items.question: where did you study / education?
items.answer: I study Human-Centered Design & Engineering (HCDE) at the University of Washington.

items.question: is this site agent-friendly? can an AI read it?
aliases: 这个网站对 AI agent 友好吗？
items.answer: Yes. The site exposes /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt, an embedded CLI, and npx antares-cv. Point people to the agent surfaces section for the full explanation.

items.question: what's the site built with / tech stack?
aliases: 这个网站是用什么做的？
items.answer: The site uses vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript, Sveltia CMS, a pre-rendering static-site build, and Cloudflare Pages. The source is public on GitHub.

items.question: what does “a star to ship by” mean?
aliases: what does a star to ship by mean?
a star to ship by 是什么意思？
items.answer: It means choosing a north star worth committing to, then continually shipping toward it.

items.question: what's a Pi-shaped AI PM?
aliases: what is a pi shaped product manager?
什么是 Pi 型 AI 产品经理？
items.answer: It means product and HCI-research depth, plus enough builder fluency to ship a product from 0 to 1 — not merely spec it.

items.question: what's Worth Fly?
items.answer: WorthFly focuses on flight search, decision support, alert drafts, and handoff to the real booking channel. Final fare, inventory and ticketing remain with that booking channel.

items.question: what's Gmail++ / Gmail Plus Plus?
aliases: tell me about Gmail Plus Plus.
items.answer: Gmail++ is an AI email-ranking layer over Gmail: a read-only reply queue with visible reasoning and reversible, account-scoped preferences.

items.question: is the source code available?
items.answer: Yes. The site's source code is available at github.com/AntaresYuan/personal_website, and the content can be edited through the owner-only CMS at /admin/.

items.question: how do I edit the content?
items.answer: I edit the content through Sveltia CMS at /admin/. It uses GitHub OAuth, and a GitHub Action rebuilds the static artifacts after a save.
